name: ubersdr-mobile
description: UberSDR mobile client — the chooser and the v2 web UI in a Capacitor shell, on Android and iOS
author: MadPsy
//chooser: The chooser page is not a copy: build.sh stages clients/electron/chooser/ into www/. Its one seam is `const api = window.ubersdr` (chooser.js), which src/api.js provides here over Capacitor plugins instead of over Electron IPC. Anything that changes the chooser changes both clients at once, which is the point.
//deps: Runtime dependencies are Capacitor itself and Preferences. Everything else the desktop client gets from Node — HTTP with per-receiver certificate trust, mDNS, the keystore — is the local plugin in android/app/src/main/java/org/ubersdr/mobile/, because those need the platform rather than a package.
